title: Learning to cook a proper dal
excerpt: Turns out the secret is the tadka, patience, and not touching it.
body:
I've eaten dal almost every day of my life and only recently learned to make one I'm proud of.

What changed:

- **Patience with the tadka.** Let the cumin actually crackle before adding anything else.
- **Salt at the end**, tasting as I go.
- **Not touching it.** Stirring every minute doesn't make it cook faster.

It's still not as good as the one I grew up with. It's getting closer.
